text:
ana: FYI linkcheck failing on anchors after we moved to Docusaurus. Example: heading 'API … examples' vs 'API...examples' mismatch.
sam: I ran linkcheck:
```
[linkcheck] WARNING: ./api/clients.mdx: anchor not found: api-...-examples
[linkcheck] WARNING: ./tutorials/quickstart.mdx: anchor not found: quickstart-apiexamples
```
ryan: looks like soft-hyphen (U+00AD), ZWJ, and fancy ellipsis are the culprits. Different slugifiers handle them differently.
nana: typo — should be @ana.
nana: proposal: add a docs preprocessor step to normalize headings: strip ​-‍, ﻿, ­, map …->"...", and collapse extra spaces.
ryan: agree. add a unit test that compares mkdocs and docusaurus slug outputs for a sample set. prevents regressions.
ci-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1501 by ana (adds sanitizer + test + migration note).
nana: added a tiny bash/perl one-liner in CI to sanitize files before linkcheck. snippet in PR description.
infra-bot: CI passed for #1501. Scheduling backfill job to normalize main; non-destructive run first.
sam: thanks — please post back when backfill completes.
infra-bot: backfill complete: 12 files changed, single commit "docs: normalize headings to avoid fragmented anchors" pushed by infra-bot. linkcheck now green.
nana: excellent, closing thread. :white_check_mark:
